info.title: EduMind quality, attempts and tutor contract proposal
info.description: ADR-0026 Proposed; all routes planned. ExerciseBlock/DisabledExerciseBlock extend T002 SceneProjection. TutorEvent extends existing operation event route, Tutor operation snapshots add kind=tutor_turn and one-attempt90s budget; T020 merges approved contracts. No admin confirmation endpoint, no automatic mastery or real Provider authorization.

x-extensions.scene_projection: Use extended ExerciseBlock or DisabledExerciseBlock for exercise slots; whole scene disabled still409. Other T002 blocks/actions unchanged.
x-extensions.operation_snapshot: Existing T002 operation snapshot route uses TutorOperation for kind=tutor_turn and original Operation otherwise.
x-extensions.events: Existing T002 events path uses Event for generation operations and TutorEvent for tutor_turn operations; same SSE owner/replay/cursor/no-store/204 semantics.

QualityDecisionDraft.description: Trusted local maintenance input only, no HTTP endpoint. Server verifies authority, exact digests/references, hard gates and impact before commit; source labels alone do not establish truth.

AttestationDraft.description: Trusted local CLI only; not student API. Final stored record additionally has authenticated local authority, rule version, server digests and database timestamp. Mechanical/model opinion alone cannot attest semantic answers/mapping.
